verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API with an OpenAPI spec, OAuth, cURL examples, a CLI, agent skills, and MCP support. None of it names an official language SDK or client library that developers can build against. An OpenAPI spec and a CLI are building blocks or adjacent tools, not official SDKs, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The OpenAPI spec and this REST API reference cover authentication, pagination, and every endpoint in detail.
